text: 中信证券指出，光互联产业的技术升级与需求爆发仍在持续演进，光模块向高速率加速迭代，光网络向NPO/CPO/OCS多维拓展。近期市场对海外地缘政策传闻存在担忧，中信证券认为，不宜过度博弈短期的政策情绪，而应回归全球AI算力建设的真实需求。
text_en: CITIC Securities noted that technological upgrading and explosive demand in the optical interconnect industry are still evolving, optical modules are accelerating iteration toward higher speeds, and optical networks are expanding in multiple dimensions toward NPO/CPO/OCS. Regarding recent market concerns over overseas geopolitical policy rumors, CITIC Securities believes that investors should not overly speculate on short-term policy sentiment, but should return to the real demand for global AI computing power construction.
